standardRegimens.title: Cisplatin + paclitaxel
standardRegimens.summary: NCI reviews the platinum–taxane combination as an established first-line comparator. The cited FDA paclitaxel label identifies cisplatin plus paclitaxel for first-line ovarian treatment; the card does not assert a specific neoadjuvant indication.
standardRegimens.sourceName: NCI PDQ and FDA paclitaxel label
standardRegimens.regulatoryNote: FDA paclitaxel label: first-line in combination with cisplatin; neoadjuvant use is not specified.

standardRegimens.title: Carboplatin + paclitaxel
standardRegimens.setting: Advanced epithelial ovarian cancer · neoadjuvant chemotherapy before interval surgery
standardRegimens.summary: NCI describes this platinum–taxane regimen in trials of stage III–IV disease receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy. Selection depends on disease and surgical context, not on a BRCA result.
standardRegimens.regulatoryNote: NCI-reviewed treatment evidence; this card does not claim an FDA-labelled neoadjuvant combination.
